# BTCDecoded documentation

> Manuals BTCDecoded publishes. The consensus specification is on thebitcoincommons.org.

- [Documentation home](https://docs.btcdecoded.org/): BLVM and Intelligence
- [BLVM manual](https://docs.btcdecoded.org/blvm/): Node operation, RPC, IBD, modules, SDK
- [BLVM manual index](https://docs.btcdecoded.org/blvm/llms.txt)
- [Intelligence guide](https://docs.btcdecoded.org/intelligence/): MCP, tools, GitHub App
- [Install BLVM](https://btcdecoded.org/install/)
- [Intelligence account](https://btcdecoded.org/account/)
- [Consensus Spec](https://thebitcoincommons.org/spec.html)
- [Orange Paper](https://thebitcoincommons.org/orange-paper.html)
